intro: Identify sample, result, method and scope without turning association into causation.

frases.estudio: En intern studie fulgte 48 ansatte i fire uker. Deltakerne registrerte konsentrasjon etter arbeidsøkter med og uten korte pauser. Gjennomsnittet var høyere etter pauser, men gruppene valgte selv når de tok dem. Rapporten sier derfor at resultatet tyder på en sammenheng; den viser ikke at pausene alene forårsaket forskjellen.
frases.alumno: An internal study followed 48 employees for four weeks. Participants recorded their concentration after sessions with and without short breaks. The average was higher after the breaks, but the groups decided for themselves when to take them. That is why the report says the result suggests a relationship; it doesn't prove that the breaks alone caused the difference.

piezas.titulo: Association is not the same as cause
texto: Ask who took part, what was measured and for how long. **Resultatet tyder på en sammenheng** expresses a suggested relationship; it doesn't prove that one variable causes another. Look for limitations and avoid extending the result beyond the sample.

pregunta.texto: Why does the report avoid claiming causation?

opciones.texto: The people chose when to take breaks
opciones.explicacion: Self-selection can influence the difference and doesn't allow it to be attributed only to the breaks.

pregunta.texto: Summarise the result and its limit in three sentences using **tyder på** or an equivalent expression of caution.

textos: Studien fulgte 48 ansatte i fire uker. Konsentrasjonen var høyere etter korte pauser. Resultatet tyder på en sammenheng, men viser ikke at pausene alene var årsaken.

piezas.explicacion: Model: finding and causal limit. Don't overstate the scope of an internal study.
